notes: The repo's concordance-flag macro file verbatim (%conctbl table-1 concordance helper and the %SplitConcordant driver, which uses an array over outcome types, vname(), substr/cat/max on the DX/PR/RX indicator strings, and a multi-output DATA step). autoexec supplies a small mock OutcomeGroups_30 dataset matching the column shape the macro reads; script.sas calls %SplitConcordant and prints the resolved concordant set and the algorithm-bound discordant set. Exercises the nested-macro concordance logic, including the special UAB-by-medication exclusion. Mock data is illustrative; no real claims data.
